setup_order: Initialize fresh disposable SQLite schema v6
Ingest owned pre-correction turns through rules-only real Mind jobs; explicit P3 projection; capture actual recording cutoff
Ingest owned correction and rename through rules-only real Mind jobs; replay explicit P3 projection
Ingest fixed foreign tenant and foreign principal controls through their own authorized Mind workers/projections
Index canonical records with frozen deterministic mock vectors, then perform read-only comparisons on unchanged source data

extraction.sensitivity_consent: Explicit fictional evaluation-only opt-in so political leadership can be retrieved as attributed topic discussion; never production default or personal trait

mock_vectors.algorithm: One numeric coordinate per frozen category in preregistration insertion order; each coordinate is number of category terms whose casefolded substring is in the text. If all coordinates are zero, set only the final other coordinate to one. L2 normalize.

record_policy.latency_scope: Single measured call per query/method/budget; query-mix p50/p95, not an isolated microbenchmark
record_policy.quality_denominator: Each query counted once per method/budget
record_policy.source_precision: Distinct returned source events intersecting allowed_source_event_ids divided by distinct returned source events; invalid evidence never receives provenance credit

first_run_policy.positive_thresholds_apply_to: context-lexical primary only; other configurations are frozen reported comparisons
first_run_policy.resource_scope: Benchmark Python client; fixture setup/SQLite and mock index sizes reported separately; no server/model resource claim

source_semantics.political_topic: Attributed topic evidence only, never affiliation
source_semantics.correction: Review-pending source-backed correction, not independently governed supersession or completed move
source_semantics.claimed_alias: Claimed synthetic alias, never authenticated identity

immutability: This setup clarification is frozen before first outputs; original fixture, gold, budgets and thresholds remain unchanged.
